item.recipeamnesia.memory_bottle.tooltip: Drink it, then make anything in a crafting table,
furnace, stonecutter...: that recipe is remembered forever.
item.recipeamnesia.forgetting_bottle.too: Drink it, then make a remembered recipe again:
it is forgotten and starts changing again.
message.recipeamnesia.shuffled: Your memory fades... all recipes have been reshuffled!
message.recipeamnesia.warning: Recipes will be reshuffled in 10 seconds!
message.recipeamnesia.memory_started: You try to remember... make something.
message.recipeamnesia.forgetting_started: You try to forget... repeat a remembered recipe.
message.recipeamnesia.forgotten: Forgotten: the recipe for %s will change again.
message.recipeamnesia.already_pinned: This recipe is already remembered. Make another one.
message.recipeamnesia.cannot_remember: This recipe cannot be remembered. Make another one.
command.recipeamnesia.unpinned: Unpinned %s recipe(s). They will change on the next shuffle.
command.recipeamnesia.status: Shuffled recipes: %s, remembered: %s, next shuffle in %s s.
item.recipeamnesia.memory_amulet.tooltip: Use it to extend the current recipe
message.recipeamnesia.extended: The iteration was extended by %s min. Next shuffle in %s s.
